statements.description: Demonstrate knowledge of locations, places, processes, environments and different scale.
Demonstrate geographical understanding of: • concepts and how they are used in relation to places, environments and processes • the interrelationships between places, environments and processes.
Apply knowledge and understanding to interpret, analyse and evaluate geographical information and issues and to make judgements.
Select, adapt and use a variety of skills and techniques to investigate questions and issues and communicate findings.
statements.weighting_overall: 24–25 (approx. 10% used to respond to fieldwork data and context(s))
